Name: Only Entities
Description: Only update entities, don't rebuild brush geometry. Conserves existing lighting/vis data.
Warning: Requires a previously compiled .bsp of the same map.

Name: No WAD Textures
Description: Embeds all textures directly into the BSP instead of relying on external WAD files at runtime.

Name: WAD Include
Description: Forces textures from the named WAD to always be embedded into the BSP, even if -nowadtextures isn't set.
Warning: Pass the WAD filename, e.g. sdhlt.wad

Name: No WAD Autodetect
Description: SDHLT: disables automatic WAD detection (SDHLT enables wad autodetect by default regardless of other settings).
Warning: Extension flag - only present in some HLT builds (e.g. SDHLT).

Name: No Clip
Warning: HLBSP must also be run with -noclip if used here.

Name: Clip Type
Description: Clip hull generation method: legacy, normalized, simple, precise, or smallest.

Name: World Extent
Description: Extends the maximum map geometry bounds beyond the default +/-32768 units.
Warning: Extension flag - only present in some HLT builds (e.g. SDHLT). Remove if your hlcsg.exe doesn't recognise it.

Name: Brush Union Threshold
Description: Warns about overlapping brushes above this percentage of overlap (0-100). Mapper debugging aid.
Warning: Slows down HLCSG considerably; leave unset for normal compiles.

Name: Texdata
Description: Increases the texture memory pool size, in KB, for maps with a large number of unique textures.

Name: Chart
Description: Prints BSP statistics before writing the output.

Name: Low Priority
Description: Runs HLCSG as a low-priority process.

Name: High Priority
Description: Runs HLCSG as a high-priority process.
Warning: Can freeze your computer while compiling.

Name: Threads
Description: Manually overrides the number of CPU threads used.
